About me

Curious engineer.
Careful builder.

I like problems where software meets data: a Kanban app that syncs in real time, a model that knows when its data has drifted, a dashboard that turns 270K users into one clear decision.

I came to my B.Tech through a Diploma in Computer Engineering, which gave me an early, hands-on start with C, C++, web development and databases. Since then I've completed internships in web development, Data Science & ML and Python, earned AWS Academy Cloud Architecting and Cloud Foundations badges, and built 15+ public projects. For my final-year project I'm building the web console for GuardRail, a risk-gated auto-remediation system for Kubernetes running on Azure. I care about the parts most portfolios skip: testing results against the source data, clean APIs, and documentation another engineer can pick up.

Now building · Final-year B.Tech project

A safety gate for
self-healing infrastructure

IN PROGRESS · 2026–27 · TEAM OF 5

GuardRail

Risk-gated auto-remediation for Kubernetes microservices. Before an automated fix (restart, scale or rollback) runs, GuardRail checks it against live cluster state. Low-risk fixes run automatically. Risky ones go to a human, with the full context.

Failure detected→Live signals→Risk engine→Execute / Escalate→Console + audit
★ My role: web console & UI/UX

I designed and built the operator console: the Overview, Decisions, Review queue, Evaluation and Policy & runtime screens. It is the interface where engineers monitor decisions, approve or reject escalated actions, and inspect evaluation results against the baselines.

12/12chaos scenarios matched the expected decision
3node Azure AKS cluster, deployed with a runbook

guardrail-console / overview

How the decision is made
  • 1Hard safety triggers always escalate, e.g. a single-replica service or an action mid-rollout
  • 2Soft risk signals combined by noisy-OR, with mitigators that lower risk
  • 3Threshold scaled by how reversible the action is, plus a global kill-switch
  • 4Fail closed: missing or stale telemetry means escalate
  • 5Every decision is stored as a RemediationAction custom resource, which doubles as the audit trail
Status
  • DONETestbed, telemetry & demo services
  • DONERisk engine & controller
  • DONEChaos evaluation harness, AKS deploy
  • PROTOWeb console (my module)
  • NEXTConsole refinements, risky held-out scenarios, third-party app validation
Why it matters
  • Knight Capital, AWS S3 and GitLab outages each lacked a pre-action safeguard. GuardRail turns each missing safeguard into a rule.
